messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: automated detector: Region fallback loop detected — probes oscillating us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. Observable: surge in 5xx and p99 latency across rtd-api routes. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/regions/fallbacks?orgId=1 :rotating_light:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: INC-4721 assigned to marcus.king (oncall). Severity: P1 — customers impacted (partial).
marcus.king: oncall here, looking. which routes are flapping?
dmitri.sre: rtd-api: model-routing policy=smart-fallback-v2. healthchecks show quick fail/success cycles from us-east probes -> traffic bouncing to us-west -> then eu -> then back. Hop-count increased, KV cache thrash.
marcus.king: timeline?
dmitri.sre: starts 2024-11-03T04:22 UTC. spike 04:22-04:35. sample logs: `probe: region=us-east status=FAIL reason=conn-reset seq=167` then 2s later `probe: region=us-east status=OK seq=168` repeated.
sophie_infra: sounds like health-check debounce too low + routing immediately failing over. smart-fallback-v2 allows cross-region hop after 1 failed probe.
alice_support: support seat: ACME reported 500s for inference calls around 04:24 UTC. Attachments from customer show increased latency and partial responses.
marcus.king: impact estimate? percentage?
dmitri.sre: quick query: errors rtd-api-prod > baseline by ~9% error-rate, p95 latency from 220ms -> 1.2s, some requests retried causing double-cost. Customers with strict region pinning see occasional model mismatch errors when routed to eu variant.
lucas_prod: we also saw KV mempressure on us-west nodes when traffic jumped, some infer workers restarted. Might be cascading.
marcus.king: immediate mitigation proposal: 1) temporarily reduce cross-region fallback (disable eu as a second-hop) 2) increase healthcheck debounce (require 3 consecutive fails) 3) pin active sessions to last-known-good region during fix. anyone can run these quickly?
sophie_infra: I can push a temporary policy patch. will do step 1 & 2.
marcus.king: do it. share commands so we can roll back.
sophie_infra: running now:```bash
# disable eu as fallback and increase debounce
rltctl policy update smart-fallback-v2 --set fallback.hops="[\"us-west\"]" --set healthcheck.consecutive_failures=3 --set healthcheck.cooldown_seconds=30
```
sophie_infra: applying...
incident-bot: system: policy smart-fallback-v2 updated by sophie_infra at 2024-11-03T04:28:12Z
dmitri.sre: verifying metrics... hold on
marcus.king: notifying customers: alice, please post in status page / send proactive email to impacted users.
alice_support: posting now. short message: "We’re investigating increased errors for inference requests in multiple regions. Mitigation in progress. No action required from customers."
dmitri.sre: graphs: error-rate starting to decline at 04:30, p95 trending down. KV restarts stopped after traffic stabilized.
lucas_prod: eu fallback disabled confirmed on control plane. us-west is handling the extra load ok.
marcus.king: good. next: set a temporary routing cooldown so we don’t flip on single probe. Is that part of policy change?
sophie_infra: yes cooldown_seconds=30 I set it to 30s for now. I’ll revert after stabilized.
dmitri.sre: runbook note: also saw a model-variant mismatch on a small subset — fallback sent some sessions to eu-quantized-v2 while clients expected us-east-v3. That caused structured output diffs and retries. 2 customers reported this.
marcus.king: important: mark customer-impact for postmortem. assign owners for follow-up.
oncall-sre: taking over monitoring until 06:00 UTC. handoff: marcus -> oncall-sre.
marcus.king: handing off. I’ll be available. watch for any re-flapping.
dmitri.sre: adding immediate actions to incident doc: - revert healthcheck sensitivity in code to use exponential backoff - add local cooldown in routing decisions (hold routing change for 60s after a successful probe) - add canary to smart-fallback to avoid three-way hop-chains
sophie_infra: suggested quick patch diff for healthchecker config:```yaml
healthcheck:
  interval: 5s
  consecutive_failures: 3
  consecutive_successes: 2
  cooldown_seconds: 30
routing:
  max_hops: 1
  prefer_same_region: true
```
alice_support: status page updated and customers alerted. ticket ACME-789 created and linked.
pagerduty-bot: INC-4721 acknowledged by oncall-sre.
oncall-sre: monitoring: no new spike for 8 minutes, error rate now ~1.2% above baseline (acceptable). keeping watch for 30m.
marcus.king: great work. postmortem owners: dmitri.sre (root cause & routing algorithm), sophie_infra (healthcheck tuning + rollout playbook), alice_support (customer comms + RCA). timeline owner: lucas_prod.
dmitri.sre: quick note for RCA: code path in smart-fallback v2 did not account for probe flapping across more than two regions; combined with low debounce we got oscillation. also a config drift: eu probe timeout lowered during last week’s deploy (accidentally) causing it to appear healthier after quick reconnects.
sophie_infra: follow-ups: create canary for policy changes, add unit tests for hop-count logic, and a guard that prevents >1 cross-region hop within 2 minutes.
alice_support: customers notified of mitigation and we’ll send a follow-up RCA draft within 24 hours.
oncall-sre: handing off to marcus.king for overnight watch at 05:30 UTC if needed.
marcus.king: I’ll take it from here until 08:00. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated (partial) — actions applied: fallback hop limit, healthcheck debounce increased. Incident channel: #incidents. Postmortem required.
marcus.king: closing thread for now. last check at 04:55 UTC looks stable. will reopen if it recurs.
